glosses: if you do what is right

renderings.bsb: if you do what is right
renderings.kjv: s long as ye do well

elsewhere.note: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”
For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.
